title: Vase
summary: Vase can hold random loot and be moved in place.

fields.Use: Open to store or retrieve contents. Most are empty, but variants may contain keys, notes or other loot. They can be moved without being picked up.
fields.Base value: 1 gp in BG3. Merchant prices vary.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay and acquisition details with pinned source evidence.
